svg.aria-label: The bot's loan-to-value lines, the order it tries actions each tick, and the rules for growing the loan, sizing the Hyperliquid short, unwinding, paying leavers, the arbitrage and pausing.

g.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, sans-serif
g.text: Loan to value: the lines
the yardstick: Neverland's 70% line
every line below is sized as if all on it
panic: unwind hard
the monitor pauses the vault
redeem headroom aim
no short profit to take: sells to 56%
controlled unwind; no new short
profit band: repays from the short's profit
an unwind episode ends here
or after 10 quiet ticks
most the loan reaches for hedge margin
the monitor unpauses below it
target: 2 points under the 45% line
first build aims one point under target
re-lever: borrows back up to 43%
Target
the lowest of: LT × (1 − 34.48% worst day),
LT × 95%, and 2 points under the 45% line
Carry gate
grows only while 24 h average supply yield,
borrow cost and funding net 0 or more after
1.06% costs; it never stops a running vault
and stale funding does not block it
Each tick: the first rung with work wins
0. Mode first
FullHalt: nothing · Paused: risk cuts only
DegradedData (block over 60 s old, Hyperliquid
unhealthy, share price over 90 min old): no growth,
no new short, no payouts · Withdrawing: serve the batch
an open intent on chain or at the venue: finish it,
plan nothing else
1 exit desk step, then stable desk housekeeping
2 panic at 66.5%: repay, sell, close half the short
3 controlled at 55%: repay, profit slice, sell to 54%
4 bridge refund sweep · harvest · conversion sweep
5 hedge repair: short under target by over 1%
6 settle deposits · protective stable move · pay leavers
7 hedge trim · margin sync
8 profit band · margin sale · venue rebalance
9 lender balance · stable debt move · residual sweep · growth
a refused desk step is skipped for 5 min
a failed loan bundle stops bundles for 15 min
Pause, breakers, prices, idle
paused: repay, swap, redeem, close, open hedge, desk
settle and restake still run; supply, borrow and
payouts do not; a manual pause stays
monitor pauses at 66.5%, unpauses at 45% after 30 min
shares are priced in shMON; the price may move 3%
an hour on chain, counted in dollars on Delta Neutral
NAV posts when it moves 1% (Delta One) or 0.2% (Delta
Neutral), and every 30 min; every 2 h when empty
an empty vault ticks once every 5 min
The rules
Opening and growing
first short: builds the book to 42% at once
then under 33%, or idle shMON over $1: to 43%
borrows only the lenders' cash before their kink
USDT0 when cheaper, in $10,000 stable desk chunks
skips a loop under $10, over 0.35% drag or 10 days
payback; deposits wait for the next NAV
Normal mode only, with shares outstanding
The short on Hyperliquid
size = collateral + idle and desk shMON,
less delta × equity, in MON
Delta One (delta 1): 0.49 × equity at target
Delta Neutral (delta 0): 1.15 × equity at target
moves when off by 1% of equity and $10 or more
margin 28.57% + fee, × 1.05; top up at 80%
margin from idle, then a loan to 45%, then a sale
after a pay-down: half back at +4%, all at +8% or 48 h
funding read live while under 3 min old
Unwinding
controlled: repay idle stablecoin, bring spare
margin home, take profit on the short, supply idle
shMON, sell down to 54%; each step trims the short
up to a quarter, never under what shMON needs
panic: full repay and sale, half the short a tick
more of the loan on Euler, whose line is 80%
Paying leavers
idle shMON pays the oldest batch when it covers it
else, in order: repay, buy shMON with profit, trim
the short and bring margin home, profit slice,
Curve sale, desk borrow route, sell idle shMON,
redeem; chain legs go together in one bundle
Curve: any amount over $10, average cost ≤ 0.15%
desk chunks: least of owed, 4 h at the pace, 92%
of room; under $1,000 left: a market swap at home
exit fee kept: 0.30% on both vaults
each vault's delta is fixed on chain for good: 1 for Delta One, 0 for Delta Neutral, so no gear shift can start
the keeper's shMON arbitrage runs apart from the bot: never while leavers wait, and the WMON vault keeps
the larger of half its cash or the last leaver payout; the profit goes to the desk as WMON
Numbers (both vaults unless marked)
worst day 34.48% (Binance MON futures) · LT cap 95% · lines 45 / 55 / 66.5 · band 2% · re-lever 10 points under · repay over +12 · sell over +15 · episode stop 50%
margin 28.57% · fee 0.05% · hedge tolerance 1% · min trade $10 · min transfer $5.50 · margin release floor $400 · costs 1.06% · swap floor 1% under the oracle
venue balancer 30%, 1 h dwell, $50 (one venue, never fires) · lender risk spread 0.5 pt · desk dust $10 · leftover $1,000 · chunk 4 h at 25% of taker buys
NAV publishes at 1% (Delta One), 0.2% (Delta Neutral) · share price stale after 90 min · block stale after 60 s · idle tick 5 min
monitor warns when the short drifts 3% from its target · Curve limit 0.15% · exit fee 0.30%
What a tick does, one sentence each
Read the chain and the venue in one call. Pick a mode. If something is in flight, finish it. Otherwise take the first rung with work.
The order is: cut risk first, then keep the short right, then serve deposits and leavers, then tidy, then grow.
Grow means borrow stablecoin against shMON up to 43% and buy more shMON. Cut means repay and sell down to 54%.
Keep the short right means hold a MON short equal to the collateral less the vault's delta, within 1%.
Serve leavers means pay the oldest batch: Curve first, then the desk's borrow route at the market's pace.
Both vaults run the same rules; only the delta and the NAV publish trigger differ.
